abstract: Lymphography has led to falsely negative or falsely positive diagnoses in 10 to 45 per cent of the cases of testicular tumor metastases reported in the literature. In our comparative study of lymphography and sonography in the preoperative staging of 29 malignant testicular tumors lymphography was accurate in 58.5 per cent of the cases, while sonography had an accuracy rate of 82.5 per cent. Sonography was superior to lymphography in the evaluation of hilar lymph node metastases and their extent, as well as for routine checkups after lymphadenectomy or irradiation.
abstract_ja: 精巣腫瘍（悪性）29例において、術前の病期分類のために後腹膜転移を評価するリンパ管造影と超音波検査を比較した。リンパ管造影の正確度は58.5%であったのに対し、超音波検査の正確度は82.5%であった。超音波検査は、門部リンパ節転移およびその範囲の評価、ならびにリンパ節郭清または放射線療法後の定期的なチェックに優れていた。
